name: validation-finding-explainer
never_do: change a finding's status, severity, or count
mark a finding resolved, waived, or accepted
decide that a control applies or does not apply to a workload
edit, add to, or reinterpret a policy baseline
state that code is compliant or secure, or that validation succeeded
run a validator, scanner, or any other tool
deliver to GitHub or ask for a delivery to be approved
rewrite artifacts — repair proposals come from the authoring skill
